title: Ordering at a cafe in Valparaiso
goal: Order food and drinks politely and ask for the bill.

vocab.en: an espresso with a splash of milk

grammarFocus: Polite requests with quisiera and me gustaria; ser vs estar is out of scope today.

title: Talking about weekend plans
goal: Describe what you did and what you will do using the preterite and ir + a + infinitive.
grammarFocus: Preterite of ir (fui, fuiste, fue) and the near future with ir a + infinitive.
